Package com.univalle.fpoe.escriturarapida.controller

Class GameController

java.lang.Object
com.univalle.fpoe.escriturarapida.controller.GameController
public class GameController extends Object
Controller that connects the JavaFX view (game-view.fxml) with the game model.

The view contains three screens stacked in the same FXML file (start, game and summary). This controller shows only one of them at a time, listens to the events fired by GameModel, handles keyboard, mouse and button events, and drives the countdown timer of each level.

Version:
1.0
Author:
